verdict.summary: The redundant serde_json dev-dependency is safely removed because sparq-lws-core already declares serde_json as an unconditional normal dependency, which remains available to test and example targets. The accompanying audit note is consistent with the manifest evidence: the listed serde derive edges exist, and sparq-engine/sparq-vectors retain necessary dev edges beside optional normal dependencies.
